takeaways: A dev box is a managed, project-ready Windows workstation hosted in Azure and built from a dev center, projects and pools.
Dev boxes rely on Microsoft Entra ID and Intune, so identity, device management, network region and cost controls must be planned up front.
Microsoft is retiring Dev Box in favour of Windows 365, so existing customers should inventory their setup and plan a migration project instead of building new dependencies.
hook: Developers often lose days waiting for a configured work machine. This episode explains Microsoft Dev Box for IT pros and platform teams: how dev centers, projects and pools fit together, how Entra ID and Intune secure it, and which mistakes to avoid. It also covers the announced retirement and what moving to Windows 365 means.
